name: Emmett Nowak
source: Emmett is a cynical and sarcastic boy. He gives off an impression that he's some kind of nerd, but there isn't anything he's particularly interested enough for him to even be “nerdy” material. He's not well-liked or popular at school, but he honestly couldn't care less at all, really, and he's contempt with who he is.
